summary: A glass card for one logged problem, with title, tags, stress meter, and actions.
purpose: Represent a single user case on the dashboard. Reach for it to show a logged mess in the active-cases grid, with an Unmess Me action that opens its plan.

anatomy.description: The tilted glass container with a subtle accent outline.
The problem, in the user's voice.
A labeled bar showing the stress score out of ten.
Secondary buttons: Unmess Me and optional View Plan.

props.name: title
props.description: The problem title, generated from the user's input; keep under about 60 characters.

props.name: tags
props.description: One to five free-form category tags.

props.name: stressScore
props.description: Emotional weight on a 1 to 10 scale, shown as a labeled meter.

props.name: accent
props.description: Accent color for the outline and meter fill.

props.name: onUnmess
props.description: Primary flow handler; opens the plan for this case.

props.name: onViewPlan
props.description: Optional handler for viewing an existing plan.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Card click handler for navigating to detail; makes the card focusable.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Override for the auto-generated accessible label.

whenToUse: Showing a logged problem or case in the dashboard grid.
Any card that carries tags, a stress read, and an Unmess action.

whenNotToUse.scenario: A plain container with no case semantics

do: Keep the title short and in the user's own voice.
Keep the card action secondary so a grid stays calm.
dont: Signal stress by color alone; the labeled meter carries it.
Put a primary button on the card; competing emphasis breaks the wall.

content.voice: First-person, wry, human. The user's own framing of the mess.

keyboard: When clickable, the card is focusable and activatable.
Action buttons are focusable and stop propagation.
aria: Renders role=article with an auto-generated label from title, tags, and stress.
accessibility.contrast: Title, tags, and meter hold at least 4.5:1 against the glass.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus when the card or its buttons are focused.

examples.title: Dashboard case
examples.code: <ProblemCard title="Lots of debt, no assets, great personality." tags={['money','debt','avoidance']} stressScore={8} accent="urgent" onUnmess={openPlan} />

related.whenToChoose: FeatureCard is a static marketing block; ProblemCard is an interactive case.
ProblemCard renders Tags internally; use Tag directly for standalone labels.
The Unmess action opens a PlanStepList for the case.
